page_title: NIC 1-1 STR | Nice v Strasbourg 03/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.

90+4' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. Nice are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90+3' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Mathis Amougou (Strasbourg) for a tough tackle.
90+1' Kojo Peprah (Nice) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' It's time for a substitution. Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) comes on in place of Lucas Hogsberg.
88' Total attempts – 19:7.
86' The linesman makes the right call and Strasbourg will have a corner.
85' The corner from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is intercepted by Mike Penders.

85' Elye Wahi (Nice) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nice.
83' The ball possession is 44:56.
83' Melvin Bard (Nice) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
81' Substitution. Zoumana Diallo (Nice) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Morgan Sanson walks off.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bernard Nguene (Nice) comes onto the pitch so that Tanguy Ndombele can be given a rest.
80' Here is a change. Samir El Mourabet is going off and Liam Rosenior gives the last tactical orders to Mathis Amougou (Strasbourg).
80' Substitution. Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) in, Julio Enciso out.
77' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Strasbourg.
76' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Elye Wahi (Nice) inside the box. He lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Mike Penders was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.

73' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Elye Wahi (Nice) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
70' Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
69' Claude Puel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) replacing Everton Pereira.
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Martial Godo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg).
66' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
65' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
63' Strasbourg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
61' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
60' A neat pass is well received by Sofiane Diop (Nice), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
59' It will be a corner kick for Nice.

59' Elye Wahi (Nice) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the left-hand post. However, he couldn't beat Mike Penders, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save. The ball is out of play. Nice win a corner kick.

58' That was a nice football moment. Morgan Sanson (Nice) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Mike Penders guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
54' 1 - 1 Elye Wahi (Nice) finds himself in a very promising position after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and fires the ball inside the right post!
52' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes.
50' Elye Wahi (Nice) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
49' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball. Nice get a free kick.
48' Melvin Bard (Nice) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mike Penders, who smothers the ball.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Claude Puel probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Tiago Gouveia. He is replaced by Elye Wahi (Nice).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Clement Turpin blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Now Strasbourg have a corner.
44' The linesman points to the corner flag, Strasbourg are going to take it.

41' Martial Godo (Strasbourg) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom right corner, but Maxime Dupe makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.

39' Strasbourg slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

37' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from the edge of the box. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
35' Clement Turpin shows the yellow card to Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) for a heavy challenge.

34' It looked like the long-range shot by Morgan Sanson (Nice) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
31' Nice keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
30' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) is penalised for a foul. Clement Turpin had a clear view and blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Nice.
28' There's an opportunity for Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
28' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Strasbourg will take a corner.
27' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.

26' A long pass finds Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
24' Sofiane Diop (Nice) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
21' Tiago Gouveia (Nice) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
21' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
18' PENALTY APPEAL after Martial Godo (Strasbourg) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
16' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) prepares to take a corner kick.

16' Nice have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag. Mike Penders makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Tiago Gouveia (Nice) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom right corner.
15' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) will deliver the corner kick.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Maxime Dupe to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
12' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

11' Kojo Peprah (Nice) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! No point in arguing there. Strasbourg will take a penalty kick.
10' The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Kojo Peprah (Nice) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Clement Turpin had an easy-decision to make.
3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
1' The referee blows his whistle as Kojo Peprah (Nice) was too aggressive in his challenge.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Nice will take the kick-off.
Clement Turpin will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
